method: Public-documentation disclosure audit of consumer/clinical CVD calculators (not runtime scrape). Two keys scored from published UI/docs: race handling; silent default / coverage messaging.

tools.name: AHA PREVENT Online Calculator
tools.notes: Race-free by equation design; professional audience; point estimates.

tools.name: ACC/AHA ASCVD Risk Estimator Plus (PCE lineage)
tools.notes: Race limited to White/AA historically; professional tool with documented populations.

tools.name: ClinCalc PREVENT
tools.notes: Documents input ranges; clamps out-of-range (Drift refuses instead).

tools.name: Typical consumer 'health age' / wellness apps (class)
tools.notes: Class-level observation from product category audits; not a named defendant. Drift's legacy arm instantiates this class.

tools.name: QRISK3 (UK)
tools.notes: Explicit ethnicity categories in validated equation — different design choice than PREVENT.

summary.drift_honest_aligns_with: professional coverage honesty + bands + no bio-age hero

limitation: Documentation audit, not blinded multi-rater screenshot coding of live consumer apps. Strengthens external grounding of the legacy arm as a class, not a named-app lawsuit.
